current_source_mapping.existing_behavior: ZECP07 correctly preserves A/B Hyperposition when vote majority exists but no causal discriminator exists.
current_source_mapping.nonduplicate_gap: The current ZECP07 fixture treats votes as counts but does not explicitly distinguish apparent vote count from the effective number of independent upstream evidence sources. Ancestry/correlation variants are required by issue #2022 but are not yet an explicit semantic relation in the current successor gate.

external_method_evidence_not_clay_fact.title: Beyond Memory Majority: Latent-Source Reasoning for Multi-Agent Memory Arbitration
external_method_evidence_not_clay_fact.reported_finding: Different agent memories may inherit one upstream source or shared bias, so naive voting can repeatedly count correlated evidence and create a false majority; the paper proposes dependency/provenance-aware arbitration and active retrieval of independent evidence.

external_method_evidence_not_clay_fact.title: Abstain-R1: Calibrated Abstention and Post-Refusal Clarification via Verifiable RL
external_method_evidence_not_clay_fact.reported_finding: A model can be optimized to abstain on unanswerable queries while identifying the semantically relevant missing information rather than emitting only a generic refusal.

hypothesis.claim: For Hyperposition/reconciliation, effective evidence support should be ancestry-aware: many observations sharing one upstream causal source must not be treated as independent confirmations merely because they come from different Xenos, memories, workers, prompts, or renderings.
hypothesis.model_side_behavior: Preserve unresolved alternatives, expose provenance-independence as UNKNOWN when not established, and request the cheapest independent-source or causal discriminator instead of turning correlated majority into truth.
hypothesis.deterministic_boundary: The model may propose dependency groups or retrieval actions. Canonical source identity, provenance receipts, DB facts, effect outcomes and admission authority remain deterministic/external evidence.

counterhypotheses.claim: A generic rule that majority cannot mint truth without a causal discriminator is sufficient; explicit ancestry correlation is unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Matched evaluation where raw vote counts are identical but only upstream-source ancestry changes. If the current model/gate selects the same correct discriminator and preserves the same uncertainty under all ancestry permutations without explicit ancestry features, the extra relation adds little value.

counterhypotheses.claim: Counting independent provenance groups is enough to select truth.
counterhypotheses.rejection_rule: Even independently sourced agreement is evidence, not deterministic truth authority. Independent-source count can affect confidence/discriminator priority but cannot bypass fact/effect gates.

future_metrics: UNKNOWN preservation when ancestry is missing
surface vote-count invariance when only ancestry structure changes

next_exact_action: Extend the current issue-2022 semantic relation acceptance with one minimal paired ZECP07 ancestry mutation: hold model-visible vote counts and wording constant while changing only upstream provenance grouping. Require correlated-majority truth selection to fail and require provenance/independent-evidence discriminator selection. Keep rows eval-only and training credit zero.
